meta.source_provenance: Email from Ben Carter to PC Jon Dixon on 4 Nov 2024 at 15:42 (provided by user)

emails.subject_summary: Query about scope of evidence required
emails.body:
Is this evidence since last week when the police went round to hers? I already sent a lot of evidence back in June, I can provide more evidence in between June and then but if it's not really needed it'd save a lot of sifting through everything.
Thanks Ben

sentence_tags.text: Is this evidence since last week when the police went round to hers?
sentence_tags.notes: Ben seeks clarity on what timeframe of evidence is required.

sentence_tags.text: I already sent a lot of evidence back in June,
sentence_tags.notes: Shows evidence was submitted months earlier; contradicts any claim of non-cooperation.

sentence_tags.text: I can provide more evidence in between June and then but if it's not really needed it'd save a lot of sifting through everything.
sentence_tags.notes: Ben demonstrates willingness but highlights heavy burden imposed by unclear requests.

contradiction_links.claim: Police lacked evidence because victim had not supplied it.
contradiction_links.reality: Victim states evidence was already provided in June; also offers to provide more.
laws_breached: Victims’ Code 2020 (Right to have evidence taken into account)

events: Ben queries scope of requested evidence.
Notes he had already sent substantial evidence in June.
Offers to provide additional evidence but highlights difficulty of re-sifting.

damages_summary.emotional: Frustration and fatigue from repeatedly having to clarify and resubmit evidence.
damages_summary.strategic: Police requests appear duplicative, risking delay while victim had already complied.
